findings.summary: The draft restates joshs's position in #1 that the Dev Fund should end before its 2028 expiry and that large holders can fund teams directly. The thread contests both points (#11, #12, #13, #15, #16), and the 2028 expiry matches #1 and #21. No tone findings and no new claims were identified.
